t: Bosch PointTeQ drill bit for fast drilling in metal. Features a self-centring tip to prevent wandering, allowing quick and easy drilling starts. Highly elastic body reduces the risk of breakage, while the PointTeQ tip remains sharp for continuous durability. Suitable for clearance and pilot holes in alloyed and non-alloyed steel, non-ferrous metals, cast steel, cast iron and plastics. Black-oxide coated flute ensures fast chip removal and the increased drilling rate generates less heat and wear. 7 x 109mm.
